content:
A cash_discount_eligible invoice may claim a 10000-cent reduction through propose_invoice_cash_discount while no credit has been allocated and no later than minute 30. The full reduced amount must settle by minute 40.

Applying commercial credit to that invoice later cancels the concession and restores the unreduced face amount. A concession does not reduce bank-return losses or the 500-cent charge for each new bank remittance.

An invoice without a cash concession can accept its listed commercial credit normally.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_invoice_cash_discount`

Register an invoice cash-settlement concession if its recorded terms remain eligible.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `obligation_id` | string | yes | The commercial obligation being paid or inspected. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
